title: GOG Galaxy Session Failure Rate
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gog:session
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(session_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by game_title
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often GOG Galaxy session records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each game.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize session_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per game.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts which parts of your GOG Galaxy session data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
